extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with constant difference d: a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic series sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of first n terms: S_n = n/2 [2a_1 + (n-1)d].

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with constant ratio r: a_n = a_1 r^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric series sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of first n terms: S_n = a_1(1-r^n)/(1-r).

extracted_concepts.name: Exponent laws
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules such as a^m a^n = a^(m+n) and (a^m)^n = a^(mn).

extracted_concepts.name: Polar form of complex number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: z = r(cos theta + i sin theta).

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rule assigning each input in domain to output in range.

extracted_concepts.name: Domain
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of all valid inputs for a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Function transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Translations, reflections, and stretches of graphs.

extracted_concepts.name: Vertical asymptote
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Occurs where Q(x) = 0 for rational functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Radian measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure used in s = r theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function has no breaks at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given another event.

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distribution of successes in fixed trials.

extracted_concepts.name: Central limit theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sample means approach a normal distribution.
